title: Zorro Ranch breeding program claims

tellings.quote: they claim that they were taken to Zoro Ranch specifically as part of a breeding program where Epstein intended to inseminate them with fetuses that had superior genetics.

related.note: Both are about what was done to women taken to Zorro Ranch. The existing story claims they were to be inseminated in a breeding program; this telling claims their eggs were harvested.

plain: Some women claim they were taken to Zorro Ranch, a property in New Mexico, in the 2000s as part of a breeding program, where the financier Jeffrey Epstein meant to inseminate them so they would carry babies with what he saw as superior genetics. The philosopher and researcher Jason Jorjani passes on their claim and points to a piece he wrote on his online newsletter about Ghislaine Maxwell. If true, it would mean the ranch was used for a deliberate scheme to breed children.
